title: UK GDP monthly estimate, November 2026 (ONS, 07:00 London / 02:00 ET) — the last activity read the February MPR gets, and the quietest month of the twelve
source: EST: ons.gov.uk/releases/gdpmonthlyestimateuknovember2026, re-fetched direct 2026-09-10 (HTTP 200, 42,041 bytes) — the ONS release page reads verbatim 'GDP monthly estimate, UK: November 2026', 'Release date: 15 January 2027 7:00am', 'This release is not yet published', and carries the Office for Statistics Regulation accredited-official-statistics kitemark. Note the publisher's own distinction: this is a plain 'Release date', not the 'Provisional release date' the ONS puts on its Q4 first quarterly estimate page — the monthly slot is firm on the ONS's own labelling. Filed estimate on two counts only: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy in market-events-data.ts (IR:/CAL:/BLS:/FED:/PJM:/SEC:/TSY:/OCC:/BEA:/CENSUS:/ISM:/CB:/UMICH:/FHFA:) has no slot for the UK Office for National Statistics, and this lane does not self-confirm. Proposed by the never-assessed initial research of uk-cpi-2027-01-20, 2026-09-09; researched and made canonical by its own lane 2026-09-10
notes: CANONICAL FILE WRITTEN BY THE never-assessed INITIAL RESEARCH 2026-09-10, superseding proposals/uk-gdp-monthly-2027-01-15.from-uk-cpi-2027-01-20.json, which was read in full first per docs/process/EVENT-RESEARCH.md. It is the FIRST canonical UK monthly-GDP entry on this calendar; every existing gdp-* id is a US BEA quarterly release. The proposer's framing — that this is the activity half of the February MPR's data run-in, paired with uk-cpi-2027-01-20 five days later — is CONFIRMED and sharpened into a stronger structural claim, and the initial research adds three measured findings the proposal did not have. FIRST, THE PLACEMENT IS TIGHTER THAN 'THE ACTIVITY HALF': six ONS release pages fetched direct 2026-09-10 (HTTP 200 each) fix the ladder — Oct-2026 data publishes 11 December 2026, Nov-2026 data 15 January 2027, Dec-2026 data 12 February 2027 — and the Q4 first QUARTERLY estimate page reads 'Provisional release date: 12 February 2027'. Against the Bank of England's own upcoming-MPC-dates page (fetched direct 2026-09-10), which lists 'Thursday 17 December' 2026 as confirmed and 'Thursday 4 February' 2027 provisional as the February MPC Summary AND Monetary Policy Report, this print is the ONLY monthly GDP release between the two announcements, and the Q4 outturn lands EIGHT DAYS AFTER the forecast round. The February 2027 MPR's Q4 GDP figure is therefore a nowcast, and this print is its last input. SECOND, WHAT THAT NOWCAST IS WORTH IS MEASURABLE: on the ONS 4dp monthly GDP workbook (monthlygdpto4dp.xlsx, fetched direct 2026-09-10), reconstructing the Q4 q/q read available at each stage across the eleven post-2013 ex-COVID Q4s gives R2 = -0.561 / MAE 0.332pp before any Q4 monthly data, R2 = +0.549 / MAE 0.161pp once October is known (11 Dec), and R2 = +0.810 / MAE 0.124pp once November is known (15 Jan), max error 0.255pp. So the January print roughly halves the remaining error VARIANCE while moving the central estimate by only about 0.04pp — it is confirmatory, not directional, and that is the honest reason its tier is LOW rather than its nationality. THIRD, NOVEMBER IS THE QUIETEST MONTH OF THE TWELVE IN UK MONTHLY GDP: m/m standard deviation 0.195pp, rank 1 of 12, against October 0.396pp and December 0.401pp, the two widest (post-2013 ex-COVID, n=11; the 1dp ECY2 timeseries reproduces the same ranking at 0.217 / 0.396 / 0.404). Mean absolute m/m is 0.166pp in November against 0.328pp in October and 0.371pp in December, and all eleven Novembers printed inside +/-0.45pp. The pairwise version of that claim FAILS honestly, though: |Nov| < |Oct| in only 5 of 11 years, a coin flip, so this is a statement about the sample distribution and never a per-year forecast. AND THE FIRST ESTIMATE IS PROVISIONAL BY CONSTRUCTION: 43 of the 44 monthly values first estimated since January 2023 carry a later revision in the current vintage, median 19.0 months from first estimate to the last recorded update. NAMING DIVERGENCE FLAGGED, NOT RESOLVED: a sibling lane proposed the same release family one day later under the OPPOSITE prefix (proposals/uk-monthly-gdp-2026-10-15.from-uk-blue-book-2026-10-30.json). This lane's id was already fixed as uk-gdp-monthly-* by its own proposer and matches the uk-cpi-/uk-ppi-/uk-labour-market- convention; the sibling's file is not this lane's to rename or delete. Whoever reconciles the two has both ids and both dates here. Tiered LOW: symbols: [], no UK listing among the ten tracked names (AAPL AMZN AVGO CRWV GOOG META MRVL MSFT MU NVDA), and a grep for gilt/sterling/GBP across trade-playbooks.md and multi-symbol-sweep.md returns nothing. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action. Ledger: docs/research/events/uk-gdp-monthly-2027-01-15.md
